milestone: 2i: blade signs and zebras follow a generated world's streets

tasks.goal: Fill in zebrasFor and placeSigns in src/sim/streetscape.js: each avenue's mid-block zebra and each neon blade sign placed on a generated world's own streets.
tasks.commit: feat(streetscape): a generated world hangs its blade signs on its own buildings and paints its own zebras
tasks.notes: The comments above zebrasFor and placeSigns are the exact rules. Remove the void lines and the stub returns. zebrasFor: const { walk } = district; const out = []; district.avenues.forEach((a, k) => { lo = Math.max(a.z0, walk.minZ) + ZEBRA_END; hi = Math.min(a.z1, walk.maxZ) - ZEBRA_END; near = district.crossings.filter((c) => c.x0 <= a.x && a.x <= c.x1); hz = HAND_MIDBLOCK[k % 3].z; let best = null; for (let z = Math.ceil(lo / ZEBRA_STEP) * ZEBRA_STEP; z <= hi; z += ZEBRA_STEP) { skip when near.some((c) => Math.abs(z - c.z) < ZEBRA_CLEAR); skip when k === 0 && Math.abs(z - carZ) < ZEBRA_CAR; if (best === null || Math.abs(z - hz) < Math.abs(best - hz)) best = z; } if (best !== null) out.push({ x: a.x, z: best }); }); return out. The loop runs upward, so strict < keeps the lower z on a tie. placeSigns: const { walk } = district; const out = []; for (const def of defs) { if (def.face === 'south') continue; if (def.sub === 'RAMEN') { ax = district.avenues[0].x; side = ramen.side; z = ramen.z; } else { ax = counterpartX(def.ax ?? 0, district); side = def.side; row = rows.find((r) => r.ax === ax && r.side === side); if (!row) continue; z = null; for (const [r0, r1] of row.runs) { lo = Math.max(r0, walk.minZ) + SIGN_IN; hi = Math.min(r1, walk.maxZ) - SIGN_IN; if (lo > hi) continue; c = Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, def.z)); if (z === null || Math.abs(c - def.z) < Math.abs(z - def.z)) z = c; } if (z === null) continue; } if (out.some((o) => o.ax === ax && o.side === side && Math.abs(o.z - z) < SIGN_GAP)) continue; out.push({ ...def, ax, side, z }); } return out. Use let for ax, side and z. Do not touch ramenBoard, MIDBLOCK, worldSigns or the constants.
